item.title: Grace 0.2.0
item.description:
First release of the native Grace for macOS, for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

  • Plays the same library as the Electron app, with crossfades, cue points, track volume and EQ.
  • Fades and crossfades run on the audio clock, so they stay smooth while the app is busy.
  • YouTube downloads keep yt-dlp up to date on their own.
  • Light, dark or system appearance in Settings.
  • Checks for updates every six hours, or from Grace → Check for Updates…
